newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Lyonnais loss seen over 160 bln Ffr -paper. [CORRECTED 11:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais loss seen over 160 bln Ffr -paper. [CORRECTED 11:33 GMT]

text.p: The latest estimate for losses and state bailout costs for state bank Credit Lyonnais is more than 160 billion francs, daily Le Parisien said on Monday.

The newspaper said the estimate was contained in a letter to finance minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn from Charles de Courson, who was the state's representative until the June 1 parliamentary election on the board of the state holding company EPFR, which is involved in the restructuring of the bank.
Le Parisien said De Courson estimated the losses at 102.8 billion and said carrying costs for loans until the year 2014 would add another 60 billion francs to the bill.
